summary: Four dead-code routes (/chat, /template-variables, /files, /files/{file_id}/content) in app.py are defined and mounted but never referenced by src/ or tests_golden/. The 80% coverage figure would be higher without this dead code.
main.py is the documented kernel entry point (CLAUDE.md 'Start here') but is never imported by app.py or any other production code. All 106 lines are at 0% coverage.

redis>=5.0, prometheus-client>=0.19, opentelemetry-api, opentelemetry-sdk, tenacity>=8.2, aio-pika>=9.4 have zero imports in src/, tools/, scripts/ and src/adapters/. httpx>=0.27 is used only in tests_postgres/, not in src/. These are installed but not used by the application.

jwt_secret (L42) is defined in Settings but has no consumer — no jwt library usage found in src/. webhook_kek (L40) is confirmed used. If JWT auth was planned but not implemented, this is an orphaned config field.
logger.warning('S2: intent model unavailable (%s)', exc) logs exception class without exc_info=True. All other exception logs in the codebase include tracebacks. Inconsistent observability pattern.
endpoint() fetches all matching rows then decrypts each in a Python loop (L89-93). No LIMIT on the query. For endpoints with many credential versions this is an N+1 decryption pattern.
Password hashing in admin_reference.py uses MD5. bcrypt is a dependency and used for API keys, but admin passwords use MD5 which is cryptographically broken.

Only reliability.py (L205) and recovery.py (L54, L71) include structured extra fields (kernel_op_id, attempt_id). All other logger calls use plain string formatting. Production incidents cannot be traced end-to-end without kernel_op_id in every log line.
Four __init__.py files (s12_execute, s13_reconciliation, s14_dead_letter, s15_final_state) are empty (0 bytes). Serve only as package markers.
6 uncovered lines (92% coverage) in exception-handling paths that are hard to trigger in unit tests.
7 uncovered lines (79% coverage) — error paths for database/stage registration failures.
35 uncovered lines (78% coverage) — lowest in src/engine/. Adapter failure and retry edge cases need fault-injection tests.
4 uncovered lines (86% coverage) — edge cases for fence lease expiry and concurrent renewal.
Several log lines use logger.warning(json.dumps({...})) instead of structured extra={...}. Fields are not indexed for log aggregation.
No pip-audit or CVE scanning was run. Dependencies (cryptography>=41, aio-pika>=9.4, httpx>=0.27) should be checked for known vulnerabilities.
